title: Reverse Shell Builder
subtitle: Generate one-liners, apply obfuscation, and save reusable configs.
payload_search_placeholder: Search by language, platform, or technique...
payload_no_results: No payloads match the current filters.
lhost_bind_hint: Not used for bind shells. Connect inbound to the target on LPORT.
lhost_staged_hint: HTTP server address that hosts your stage file (rs.sh).
lhost_http_hint: HTTP callback server address for HoaxShell-style polling.
lport_bind_hint: Port opened on the target. Connect with nc TARGET_IP LPORT.
recommended_listener_hint: Run this on your attack box before executing the payload.
recommended_listener_http_note: Use the HTTP callback server below instead of a TCP listener.
stage_file_hint: Host this file on your HTTP server, then run the staged command on the target.
http_server_hint: Download and run the included Python callback server. It serves commands on GET and accepts target output on POST.
invalid_input: Fix invalid input to generate a command.
validation_error: Fix the highlighted fields to generate a command.
validation_field_lhost: Use an IP address or hostname without shell metacharacters.
validation_field_shell: Use a shell path without spaces or shell metacharacters.
validation_field_http_port: HTTP port must be between 1 and 65535.
obfuscation_note: Obfuscation is applied locally in the browser and never sends the payload anywhere.
obfuscation_compat_note: Only modes compatible with the selected payload are shown.
obfuscation_bash_base64: Bash base64 - Decode then pipe to shell
card_authorized_only: Use only in explicitly authorized environments.

obfuscation_notes.url: URL-encoded output for HTTP parameter or form contexts.
obfuscation_notes.bash-base64: Base64 wrapper decoded locally before execution.
obfuscation_notes.bash-ifs: Spaces replaced with '${IFS}' for shell argument filtering.
obfuscation_notes.bash-rev: Command is stored reversed and reconstructed with rev.
obfuscation_notes.powershell-concat: PowerShell command split into concatenated string chunks.
obfuscation_notes.python-chr: Command reconstructed from character codes before execution.
